description: This file is a shell script for configuring Wi-Fi interfaces using OpenWRT's netifd system, including functions for setting up and tearing down wireless PHYs, managing mesh parameters, and integrating with supplicant and hostapd.

methods.name: phy_suffix
methods.description: Generates a suffix for PHY based on radio index and separator.

methods.name: reset_config
methods.description: Resets the hostapd and wpa_supplicant configuration for a given PHY and radio.

methods.name: get_channel_frequency
methods.description: Returns the frequency for a given band and channel.

methods.name: setup_phy
methods.description: Configures the physical wireless interface with specified parameters.

methods.name: iw_htmode
methods.description: Determines the HT mode string based on configuration.

methods.name: config_add
methods.description: Adds a key-value pair to a configuration object if value is not null.

methods.name: config_add_mesh_params
methods.description: Adds mesh-specific parameters to a configuration object.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Main function to set up wireless interfaces, including validation, configuration, and starting supplicant/hostapd.

methods.name: teardown
methods.description: Tears down the wireless interface configuration, resetting PHY.
